@sofia.marchetti, the right number is **10%**. I've posted that in #coastal-team.

Bettina's 12% note on Nov 17 was a misread, and she retracted it in the same thread. The 10% matches the signed amendment, which took effect Nov 1, 2025. The 2026 renewal order form also carries the existing 10% over unchanged. For copies of the signed paperwork for the brief, June Osei-Lark on the deal desk is the right person to ask.
